description: Maharashtra CM Devendra Fadnavis has directed officials to develop an AI platform to monitor app-based taxis, drivers, working hours and trip allocation
body_lead: Maharashtra CM Fadnavis calls for AI monitoring of cab operations and driver working hours CM orders to develop advanced digital platform to surveil app-based passenger transport services; stresses need for passenger safety Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis. FILE PIC Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis on Thursday directed the transport department to develop an advanced digital platform integrated with artificial intelligence (AI) to monitor app-based passenger transport services, including vehicles, drivers, their working hours, and trip allocation.
